claims: Netflix is streaming "BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG".
"BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG" is a live concert from Gwanghwamun Square in Seoul.
"BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG" streams on Netflix on March 21, 2026, at 8 p.m. KST.
8 p.m. KST on March 21, 2026, is 4 a.m. PT.
8 p.m. KST on March 21, 2026, is 7 a.m. ET.
"BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG" is one hour long.
"BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG" is free to stream with a Netflix subscription.
"BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG" is included with all Netflix subscription plans.
The performance features all seven BTS members.
The Hollywood Reporter notes that BTS member RM may have limited choreography due to an ankle injury.
The concert supports BTS's new album Arirang.
The concert is BTS's first major live performance following their military service hiatus.
CNET says a documentary titled "BTS: The Return" is set to release on Netflix on March 27, 2026.
